log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file for the Aodh expirer.

log_format.description: Format string for log messages (Python logging format syntax).

log_date_format.description: Date/time format used in log messages.

log_dir.description: Directory to store log files (used with 'file' logging handler).

transport_url.description: Message broker URL for RPC communication (e.g., RabbitMQ or Redis).

connection.description: SQLAlchemy connection string for the Aodh database.

service_credentials.description: OpenStack service credentials for API authentication.

project_name.description: OpenStack project (tenant) name for the service.

region_name.description: Region name for service endpoint lookup (optional; leave blank if unused).

project_domain_name.description: Domain name containing the service project.

user_domain_name.description: Domain name containing the service user.

verify.description: Whether to verify SSL/TLS certificates for API calls.

extra_sections.description: Arbitrary additional config sections for site-specific tuning (key = section name, value = dict of key=value pairs).
